description: Optional Stop hook — runs /judge-codex:final automatically when the last assistant turn produced a /review consolidated report. Disabled by default; enable by adding 'STOP' to JUDGE_CODEX_HOOKS env var.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$JUDGE_CODEX_HOOKS" == *STOP* ]]; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/codex-companion-judge.mjs" judge --stage final --slug "${JUDGE_CODEX_LAST_SLUG:-unknown}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi'
